feat(settings): add appearance and behavior settings modal

- Background presets: Solid, Grid, Dots, Gradient (saved to localStorage)
- Behavior toggles: Reduce Motion (disables animations/transitions)
- Behavior toggles: Price change badges (show/hide 7-day % on cards)
- Smoother card entrance animations (gentler ease instead of spring)
- Smooth theme/background transitions via CSS variables
